title: Reproducibility package for: Deep Learning for Human Sperm Analysis: Data, Architectures and Evaluation: A Systematic Review.
description: Search, screening, selection materials for the PRISMA 2020 systematic review 'Deep Learning for Automated Human Sperm Analysis. Datasets, Synthetic Data, Architectures and Evaluation: A Systematic Review': database search exports (Scopus, PubMed; 27 May 2026), deduplicated screening set, title/abstract and full-text decisions of both reviewers with third-reviewer adjudication, citation-tracking inputs and outputs (citationchaser over Lens.org; 1 July 2026), extraction tables and the inter-rater agreement script. See README.md for the folder structure.
